release_notes:
1. Universal Cart Activity Tracking: Accurately maps additions, quantity increases, decrements, and product removals to GA4 add_to_cart and remove_from_cart events using pure mathematical state deltas without DOM querying.
2. Removed Item Metadata Preservation: Retains full product attributes (SKU, brand, category, variant, price) even after items disappear from updated cart.
3. Multi-Product Batch Support: Correctly partitions simultaneous updates across multiple products into separate add/remove events.
4. Failure & Retry Protection: Suppresses tracking events on failed or out-of-stock cart operations.
